metadata.title: Riverside Camping
metadata.description: Learn how to pitch a tent by the Siegel River, catch local cod, and spot unique Australian wildlife on this retreat. Or, you can sit back in the shade with a cool beverage and a book until it's too dark to read, then tell stories around a campfire.
